title: Job pipeline
description: gateway → scraper → analysis. To be filled once those services expose their metrics.

options.content:
### Waiting for metrics from gateway-svc, scraper-svc and analysis-svc

This dashboard will answer: **where is a job stuck — queue, scraping, analysis, or the LLM?**

| Panel to build | Metric needed | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Jobs created / min | `gateway_jobs_created_total{mode}` | Youssef |
| Jobs waiting in queue | `gateway_queue_waiting_jobs{queue}` | Youssef |
| WebSockets open | `gateway_websocket_connections` | Youssef |
| Scrape duration p95 | `scraper_job_duration_seconds` | Madani |
| Reddit 429s | `scraper_reddit_requests_total{status}` | Madani |
| Analysis time per stage | `analysis_stage_duration_seconds{stage}` | Youssef |
| LLM calls by status | `analysis_llm_requests_total{model,status}` | Youssef |
| Jobs done vs failed | `analysis_jobs_total{result}` | Youssef |

Full spec: `Study/monitoring/102-metrics-per-service.md` and the GitHub issue *"Monitoring: add /metrics"*.
How to fill it: build the panels in the UI, Export → Export as JSON (classic, "use in another instance"), replace `grafana/dashboards/pipeline.json`.
